summary: Verified all 8 requested features for Google OAuth linking, Mobile Welcome Screen, and existing auth flows. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed for /api/auth/google/link (401 for invalid session, 401 without auth, 422 for missing field), /api/auth/google/unlink (401 without auth, 400 'No Google account linked' for user without linked account), /api/user/profile (returns google_linked + has_password booleans), plus regression on email/password login, /api/auth/google/session and guest login. Frontend: /welcome route renders MobileWelcomeScreen with 3 buttons (Get Started -> /register, I Have Account -> /login, Browse as Guest). Google 'Continue with Google' button visible with colored SVG icon on both /login and /register. Settings > Security tab shows Google Account section with 'Link Google Account' button (admin has no google_linked) and Password section beneath it. Clicking 'Link Google Account' correctly initiates Emergent OAuth handshake (redirects through auth.emergentagent.com -> accounts.google.com).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3663+ lines - should be split into modules (auth/, books/, subscriptions/, admin/, apple/) for maintainability. Not blocking but recommended.

UserResponse model in server.py does NOT include google_linked field, so /api/auth/me does not surface it. SettingsPage correctly uses /api/user/profile which does return google_linked+has_password. Consider standardizing on one endpoint or adding google_linked to UserResponse for consistency.
MobileWelcomeScreen uses --safe-area-inset-* CSS variables for iOS notch/home-indicator handling - correct approach for Capacitor.
BookLoader.jsx uses proper cleanup of setTimeout via useEffect return - no memory leak.
Google link/unlink endpoints properly use `_id: 0` projection to avoid MongoDB ObjectId serialization issues.
Google unlink endpoint correctly guards against unlinking when password is not set (would lock user out) - good UX safety net.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin account which has no google_linked flag (required to test 'not linked' state)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features work correctly: (1) /api/auth/google/link returns 401 for invalid session_id, 401 without auth, 422 for missing body field. (2) /api/auth/google/unlink returns 400 'No Google account linked' when user has no google_linked flag, 401 without auth. (3) /api/user/profile now returns google_linked (bool) and has_password (bool) fields used by Settings page. (4) /welcome route accessible with 3 data-testids: welcome-get-started-btn, welcome-login-btn, welcome-guest-btn. (5) Google buttons on /login (data-testid='google-login-btn') and /register (data-testid='google-signup-btn') both show colorful Google SVG. (6) Settings > Security tab has data-testid='link-google-btn' (when not linked) or 'unlink-google-btn' (when linked with password). Cannot end-to-end test actual Google OAuth handshake without real Google credentials, but all layers we can test are verified.
